notablePrerequisites:
Dack's Duplicate on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Dack's Duplicate do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Dack's Duplicate.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Dack's Duplicate.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
